name: lue
releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
* Use Python 3.13 in macOS CI by @OliverSchmitz in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/750
* Fix handling of user's command arguments by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/753
* Update documentation by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/755
* Bump max Python version used in C/I to 3.13 by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/757
* Add missing return statement to Python wrapper for `cell_index` by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/761
* Set north, west and cellsize for pcr.report by @OliverSchmitz in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/769
* Fix typo in `sqrt` of `lue.pcraster` Python subpackage by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/770
* Consider using config mode in find_package GDAL by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/773
* lue.pcraster; lddcreate does not accept string argument by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/776
* Remove dependency on span-lite by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/780
* Rename all src directories to source by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/781
* Refactor I/O library and make it easy to try out and compare alternative implementations by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/779
* When scaling over cores, make partition shape equal to array shape by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/787
* Add overloads for reclassify that result in integral arrays by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/786
* Add support for reading hyperslab using gdal by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/789
* Fix spelling of ifthen / ifthenelse and mention where by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/792
* Replace docopt by cxxopts by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/795
* Add initial support for parallel I/O by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/798
* Refactor, add docs by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/802
* Add docstring to uniform by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/803
* Use array shape as default partition shape in single thread case by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/801
* Fix from_numpy crash by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/804
* Prevent to_gdal to write outside of the raster's shape by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/807
* Replace future.wait by get by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/809
* Fix crash in from_lue unit test by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/810
* Only read tss files at first access by @OliverSchmitz in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/811
* Add -Werror=missing-include-dirs to GCC by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/816
* Reverse input/output arguments of `lue_translate` by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/819
* Add Python quickstart by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/821
* Feature request and template chooser added by @OliverSchmitz in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/825
* Install the `lue_framework_io` library by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/823
* Add a contributor license agreement by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/829
* Remove call to `lfr.wait()` in PCRaster sub-package's `numpy2pcr` by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/832
* Verify `rate_limit` results in slides per time step finished by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/834
* Fix `lue_scalability` for distributed runs on eejit by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/836
* Fix failing Windows C/I workflow by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/826
* Make `scalability.py` reserve NUMA nodes instead of cluster nodes as much as possible by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/843
* Add script which extracts / summarizes information form a `scalability.lue` file by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/844
* Add normal and uniform overloads that return a scalar by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/851
* Add resample operation by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/849
* Fix failing Windows C/I build by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/857
* lue_framework_io_lue unit tests fails once is a while by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/859
* Fix segmentation fault when importing LUE on macOS by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/860
* Use explicit instantiations for uniform and friends by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/863
* Prepare for release of LUE 0.3.10 by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/864
* Try to get lftp to play nice, part III by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/867
* Add support for parallel I/O by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/876
* Port LUE to HPX 1.11.0 by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/878
* lue.pcraster max and min differ when testing for non_spatial_to_spatial by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/879
* Re-run pre-commit hooks on all code by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/881
* Refactor, document, trying to speed-up the build by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/883
* Release LUE 0.3.10 by @kordejong in https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/pull/882


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/computationalgeography/lue/compare/0.3.9...0.3.10
